scope: CPU5 minimum synchronous Trap end-to-end simulation
limitation: Fixed vector and debug snapshots only; no CSR/MRET/IRQ, MMIO, M extension, SoC/cache integration, STA, or board performance claim.
checks: independent machine-word decoder and byte RAM interpreter
fault and killed instructions have no retirement/GPR/BP/D effects
earlier speculative ID redirect revoked by older LOAD error
fresh handler normal ALU/LOAD/STORE and self-loop
all RAM words, seven defined GPRs and 25 untouched unknown GPRs
104 fault x ID/EX x predictor x backpressure combinations
